title: dashboardAC

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: A Auth : service-a-auth, C Order : service-c-order

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Jaeger Trace ID
list.description: Trace ID for the waterfall panel.

panels.title: Availability SLI · SLO ≥ 99.9%
panels.description: 2xx / (2xx + 5xx) for POST /orders/checkout. Rolling 30-day window, limited by available history. Business and client 4xx are shown separately. The 99.9% objective comes from the course.

panels.title: Latency SLI (p95) · lab SLO ≤ 2.5 s
panels.description: 95th percentile of checkout response times over 5 minutes, all HTTP statuses. Amber starts at 1.5 s. The 2.5 s objective is a lab threshold.

panels.title: Error budget remaining · 30 days
panels.description: Remaining share of the 0.1% error budget over the available 30-day window. Negative values indicate an overrun.

panels.title: Eligible requests · up to 30 days
panels.description: Estimated count of 2xx and 5xx checkout responses observed within the last 30 days.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape status
panels.description: Current Prometheus scrape result for each selected service.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx) · last 5 min
panels.description: Estimated count of completed 5xx responses in the last 5 minutes. Amber above zero and red at five, as lab severity thresholds.

targets.expr: sum by (job) (increase(http_requests_total{job=~"service-a-auth|service-c-order",route!~"/healthz|/metrics",status=~"5..",job=~"${service:regex}"}[5m])) or on(job) (0 * sum by (job) (increase(http_requests_total{job=~"service-a-auth|service-c-order",route!~"/healthz|/metrics",job=~"${service:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Checkout requests · last 5 min
panels.description: Estimated count of checkout responses across all HTTP statuses in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Checkout throughput by HTTP status
panels.description: 201 confirmed; 402 payment declined; 409 inventory conflict; 5xx server failures.

panels.title: Error budget burn rate
panels.description: 5-minute and 30-minute error ratios divided by the 0.1% budget. At 1×, the budget is consumed at the pace implied by the SLO.

panels.title: A Auth · Errors (HTTP 5xx)
panels.description: Share of measured HTTP requests that returned 5xx. Probe and metrics endpoints are excluded.

panels.title: C Order · Errors (HTTP 5xx)
panels.description: Share of measured HTTP requests that returned 5xx. Probe and metrics endpoints are excluded.

panels.title: HTTP 4xx and 5xx by service and route
panels.description: 5xx indicate server failures. 4xx include rejected credentials or tokens and expected payment and inventory outcomes.

panels.title: RED details · authentication, routes and percentiles
Authentication throughput by endpoint and status
Authentication success and rejection rates
panels.description: 2xx successes and 401 rejections as percentages of each authentication endpoint's traffic.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="service-a-auth",route=~"/auth/login|/auth/verify",status=~"2..",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(route) (0 * sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="service-a-auth",route=~"/auth/login|/auth/verify",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="service-a-auth",route=~"/auth/login|/auth/verify",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

100 * ((sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="service-a-auth",route=~"/auth/login|/auth/verify",status="401",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(route) (0 * sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="service-a-auth",route=~"/auth/login|/auth/verify",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="service-a-auth",route=~"/auth/login|/auth/verify",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: A Auth · mean latency and percentiles
C Order · mean latency and percentiles

targets.expr: sum by (job, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"service-a-auth|service-c-order",route!~"/healthz|/metrics",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"service-a-auth|service-c-order",route!~"/healthz|/metrics",job=~"${service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Estimated concurrent requests
panels.description: Estimated mean in-flight requests from elapsed time per second, most meaningful during steady traffic.

panels.title: Request volume by service
panels.description: Estimated completed requests over the selected time range.

panels.title: Checkout volume by HTTP status
panels.description: Estimated number of checkout responses by status over the selected time range.

panels.title: Confirmed checkouts within 2.5 s
panels.description: Share of HTTP 201 checkouts completed within 2.5 s over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Checkout p95 by HTTP status
panels.description: 95th-percentile checkout response time grouped by final HTTP status.

panels.title: Checkout outcome rates
panels.description: Share of observed checkout requests corresponding to each business outcome.

panels.title: Successful scrapes over the selected range
panels.description: Percentage of Prometheus scrapes that succeeded in the selected time range.

panels.title: Scraped samples and new series
panels.description: Number of samples scraped and number of new time series added at each scrape.

panels.title: Recent checkout traces
panels.description: Up to 20 recent service C checkout traces, with direct Jaeger links.

panels.title: A Auth · structured logs
panels.description: A Auth application logs from Loki.

panels.title: C Order · structured logs
panels.description: C Order application logs from Loki.

panels.title: Warning and error log rate
panels.description: Warning and error lines per second, grouped by service and level.

panels.title: Warning and error logs by event
panels.description: Lines per five minutes, grouped by service and structured event.

targets.expr: sum by (service, event) (count_over_time({job="cloudstore",service=~"service-a-auth|service-c-order",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json | __error__="" | level=~"warn|error" | event!="" [5m]))

panels.title: Trace waterfall
panels.description: Jaeger spans for the selected Trace ID.

panels.title: U · CPU usage (cores)
panels.description: CPU cores consumed. 1.0 represents one fully used logical CPU.

panels.title: U · Memory working set
panels.description: Container memory excluding inactive file cache, as reported by Docker Stats.

panels.title: U · Memory utilization
panels.description: Percent of the effective limit reported by Docker. The limit may be the Docker VM's memory when no container cap is configured.

panels.title: S · CPU throttling (s/s)
panels.description: Aggregate CPU throttling time, in seconds per second. A rise indicates enforced CPU limits. The aggregate can exceed 1.

panels.title: S · Major memory page faults/s
panels.description: Major page faults per second. A rise can be a sign of memory pressure or file-backed I/O.

panels.title: E · Container restarts
panels.description: Docker restart count for the current container lifetime.

description: CloudStore A/C · Checkout SLI/SLO, HTTP RED, Loki logs, Jaeger traces and Docker USE metrics.
